body_es: Databricks combina lago de datos y warehouse (lakehouse). Delta Lake agrega ACID, versionamiento y performance a Parquet. Workspace es entorno colaborativo con notebooks ejecutando Spark. Clusters escalables pueden ser all-purpose (reutilizables) o job-specific (single-use). SQL Endpoint proporciona interfaz SQL optimizada. Integración con dbt, Airflow y Git nativa.
body_en: Databricks combines data lake and warehouse (lakehouse). Delta Lake adds ACID, versioning and performance to Parquet. Workspace is collaborative environment with notebooks running Spark. Scalable clusters can be all-purpose (reusable) or job-specific (single-use). SQL Endpoint provides optimized SQL interface. Native integration with dbt, Airflow and Git.
example_code:
# Databricks notebook
df = spark.read.parquet('/mnt/data/raw')

# Crear Delta table
df.write.format('delta').mode('overwrite').save('/mnt/data/delta/users')

# SQL en mismo notebook
%sql
SELECT COUNT(*), status 
FROM delta.`/mnt/data/delta/users`
GROUP BY status

# Time travel
df_old = spark.read.format('delta').option('versionAsOf', 5).load('/path')
example_output: Notebook colaborativo ejecutando Spark + SQL, datos en Delta con versionamiento, 10x más rápido que Parquet puro.
